{"claims":[{"claim_text":"A Republican president will challenge America's military leaders to envision a new architecture of American defense for decades to come.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"A Republican president will balance the need to prepare for information age battles while keeping conventional fighting skills second to none.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The administration's defense budgets have been eating their seed corn by slashing spending on modernization to levels not seen since before the Korean War.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Slashing spending on modernization has undermined the health of the defense industry.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Slashing spending on modernization has produced a \"death spiral\" for the U.S. defense capability of the future, according to one administration official.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Even elite combat units are scraping the bottom of the barrel to find funds for basic training.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"A Republican president, working in partnership with a Republican Congress, will push beyond marginal improvements and incorporate new technologies and new strategies.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"A Republican government will use a time of relative American strength in the world to prepare for a different kind of future.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"In the twenty-first century, U.S. forces must be agile, lethal, readily deployable, and require a minimum of logistical support.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"U.S. forces must be fully prepared for possible enemy use of weapons of mass destruction.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
